name: Datenshi Bokujou ~Fallen Angel~
source:
There is a world where only women are born. Occasionally a man is sent from the sky to maintain population. Here is such man who has no memory of previous life. Unlike earlier sent men he's not a crude person. He wants to get memories back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一個只會誕生女性的世界。為了維持人口，天空偶爾會送來一名男性。這個男人就是其中之一，但他沒有前世的記憶。與之前被送來的男人不同，他並不是粗魯之人。他想找回自己的記憶。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]VNDB Review[/url]］
